points.text: Is the Arabic text easy to read at phone size?
Does the layout read right to left, with the start of each row on the right?
Do the arrows and chevrons point the right way for Arabic?
Do the numbers and amounts read correctly, with the currency beside the right figure?
Is the amount due the clearest thing on the screen?
Does the back button sit on the right with its arrow pointing right?
Do the Gregorian and Hijri dates each read in a sensible Arabic order?
Does the phone number 050 123 4567 stay left to right and unscrambled?
Does the "You have 3 items" line read as one clean Arabic sentence?
Is the pay button full width and easy to spot?
